title: Bellini Systems - Globaljig universal jig and USB vehicle data-sheet database
notes: globaljig.com redirects to this Italian page, read on 2026-10-15. In its Evolution 5000 section it states 'Il nuovo database schede USB permette la consultazione delle schede di tutte le vetture da riparare' (the new USB data-sheet database gives access to the sheets of all vehicles to be repaired), with no vehicle list, no licence or subscription terms and no mention of Porsche. The manufacturers named as endorsing Globaljig do not include Porsche. A 993 sheet is not publicly confirmed.
